nodes.name: FATAL - Invalid Sender
nodes.notes: Connect output of this node to an error notification email node and a workflow halt. Do not proceed to Stage 2.

nodes.name: Call Claude API (Parser)
nodes.notes: SETUP: Create an HTTP Header Auth credential named 'Anthropic API Key'. Header name: x-api-key. Value: your Anthropic API key. Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514 is recommended for production. Use claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 for cost savings during testing.

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Inventory] Manual Review Required — ' + $json.envelope.senderEmail + ' — Run: ' + $json.envelope.workflowRunId }}
parameters.html:
=={{ '

ACME MANUFACTURING

Inventory Manual Review Required

Submission Details

From' + $json.envelope.senderEmail + '
Sender Name' + $json.envelope.senderName + '
Subject' + $json.envelope.subject + '
Received' + $json.envelope.receivedAt + '
Customer ID' + $json.envelope.customerId + '
Total Items' + $json._meta.itemCount + '
Items Needing Review' + $json._meta.manualReviewCount + '
Run ID' + $json.envelope.workflowRunId + '

Items Requiring Review

' + $json.items.filter(i => !i.itemResolved && (i.resolutionConfidence ?? 0) < 0.75).map((i, idx) => '').join("") + '
LineRaw Item RefTypeQtyConfidenceNotes
' + i.lineNumber + '' + i.rawItemRef + '' + i.itemRefType + '' + (i.qtyOnHand ?? "N/A") + " " + i.uom + '' + i.resolutionConfidence + '' + (i.parseNotes ?? "—") + '

All auto-resolved items have continued to Stage 2 processing. Please review the items above and update customer-SKU mappings in SAC where applicable.

This is an automated message from the Acme Intelligent Inventory System. Do not reply to this email.

' }}

nodes.name: Send Manual Review Notification
nodes.notes: SETUP: Create an SMTP credential for your outbound mail server. Update fromEmail and toEmail to match your environment. The ops team will receive a formatted HTML table of all items that could not be auto-resolved.

nodes.name: Stage 1 Complete — Output
nodes.notes: Connect output of this node to the Stage 2 workflow trigger (Execute Workflow or webhook). The full working object in $json is ready for Stage 2 customer resolution. Key fields Stage 2 needs: envelope.senderEmail, envelope.senderName, items[].rawItemRef, items[].itemRefType, items[].upc, items[].customerPartNum

parameters.subject: =Inventory Submission — Missing or Invalid Account Numberl - {{$now.format('yyyy-MM-dd')}}
parameters.html:
=

ACME MANUFACTURING

Dear {{ $('Microsoft Outlook Trigger').item.json.from.emailAddress.name }},

Thank you for submitting your inventory to Acme Manufacturing

Unfortunately we were unable to process your submission because a valid 7-digit Acme account number was not found in the subject line of your email.

Please resubmit your inventory with your account number in the subject line.

Example: Lipseys 1004441

If you need your account number please contact your Acme sales representative.


Thank you,
Acme Manufacturing
Sales Operations

This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.
